				[8415] StaticText "I got this ignoring the reviews, thinking maybe it didn't work for them, but it would for me. I wear a headset over ear for 40 hours a week at work, no gaming. It's super uncomfortable. I get red and swollen ears by the end of day. I was hopeful this would be a comfortable solution for me, and I would't mind using it gaming even. I was wrong. I didn't like it, the sound is just like two tiny bluetooth speakers on your shoulder. Even worse, they are making the same sound, no differences. Even worse still, one is faster than the other at sound by a second. So you're hearing a garbled echo. I hope they make a second generation that works better, as I do want a comfortable headphone solution, it's just being comfortable is where this ends. Will be returning.In summary:Good:-It's comfortable.-It looks nice.-Controls are in an easy to use location, and are very easy to understand and intuitive to use without removing the headset..Bad-Speakers are tiny sounding, even on the loudest setting.-Speakers are not surround sound. They each play the same thing on left and right.-Speakers have a delay on one side. So one side is about a second or half a second behind, so it comes out as a garbled mess to me. Mind you, this isn't bluetooth. This is hard wired with a 3.5mm cable. So there should be no delay.-This is not bluetooth, and is battery operated. The instructions state to not charge it while you use it, and the battery life isn't great. I couldn't make it through a 4 hour gaming session, let alone a 10 hour work day."

				[8429] StaticText 'I really wanted this headset to be good.. unfortunately Hori did not. Personally, I find the Pulse 3D headset uncomfortable during long game sessions, so I was hoping that this could be a suitable alternative.This is an average headset - at best. It is comfortable to wear and the controls are easy to reach. Also, I found spoken dialog (game characters) sounds OK. That is where the pros end for me.This is in no way a 3D headset - this is just a speaker on your shoulders. The audio quality is hollow - nothing is emphasized. Everything sounds flat and ultimately, it distracts from the gameplay experience. I did not try the mic function, so I am not sure about its quality.If this headset was $30 it may be acceptable - maybe. But for Hori to call this a 3D headset for PS5 at a $100 price point, no, it is not worth it in my view. I would not recommend this product; the audio quality is simply too flat with no bass and no surround.'
